title: Study
description: v1 contract (task M5-T125, directive D-090 Wave 0; derived lane plan docs/lanes/PARALLEL_BUILD_PLAN.md section 5) for ONE shared study per property (plan docs/PRODUCT_PLAN_CURRENT_2026-09-28.md section 9 'One shared study per property', task M1-09). The study holds: the property; its tax lots with approximate sizes and the architect's selection (section 3 step 2), carrying the exact statement 'Based on the lots you selected — the app does not verify the zoning lot'; the SHARED site - site facts (site_fact.schema.json) used by every option (section 3 step 3, section 4); the options - each an independent add-on selection plus option inputs (goal, program, floor-to-floor heights, assumptions, existing-building plan; sections 3 steps 4 and 6, 5); the selected option that drives the report; and the revision. Results are NOT part of a study (results.schema.json); a study never contains example values (section 9 'No example data in real work').

contract_version.description: CLOSED enum of published study contract versions. 1.0.0 = M5-T125 initial shape (D-090 Wave 0). New versions are admitted only by an accepted contract task that appends to this enum.

study_id.description: Stable id of the study (one per property, plan section 9).

property.description: The confirmed property (plan section 3 step 1). For a condominium this is the billing BBL; its tax lots are the base lots (section 3 step 2: 'Lots are tax lots, not condo apartments').

address.description: Confirmed address as displayed; null when the property was found by BBL only.

lots.description: Every tax lot of the property, each with its approximate size and whether the architect selected it ('This property has N lots: use all (default), or pick', plan section 3 step 2).

lot_selection.description: The architect's statement of the site (plan section 3 step 2; decision Q2).

mode.description: 'all' (the default) or a picked 'subset' of lots.

statement.const: Based on the lots you selected — the app does not verify the zoning lot
statement.description: The exact label every result carries (plan section 3 step 2; check C-9).

site.description: The site shared by ALL options: facts and site inputs such as street widths and measurements (plan section 9). Changing a site fact marks dependent results in every option out of date.

facts.description: Site facts, each with its measurement rank, label and source (site_fact.schema.json). May be empty while facts are still being fetched.

options.description: Independent options (plan section 9: each option is an add-on selection plus option inputs; changing one option affects only that option).

selected_option_id.description: The option_id of the option that drives the report (plan section 9). Must equal one options[].option_id (cross-field check done by the study store; not expressible in this validator's keyword subset).

_expected_failure.description: FIXTURE-ONLY annotation stating the intended defect of an invalid fixture (packages/contracts README convention). Producers NEVER emit this key.

lot.description: One tax lot. Its approximate size is either a positive number with a known measurement rank, or null with rank 'unknown' - never 0 (plan section 9).

approximate_lot_area_sq_ft.description: Approximate lot area in square feet as listed in the lot choice; null when unknown.

selected.description: Whether the architect included this lot in the site.

combination.description: Whether the selected lots can be combined: only lots on one block that touch; otherwise the combination is not offered and the reason is shown (plan section 3 step 2, section 8).

reason.description: Plain-English reason; required when not_offered, null otherwise.

option.description: One option: an add-on selection plus option inputs. The goal, program and assumptions are saved with the option (plan section 5, task M1-25).

name.description: Display name, e.g. 'Option B' (used in the report identification line, plan section 9).

addon_selection.description: The optional add-on switches and their state. Optional add-ons start off (plan section 5); automatic add-ons that follow from the site are always included and are not switches. Add-on ids come from the reviewed add-on catalog (plan section 6) and are not enumerated here.

program.description: Program components of this option, set through the add-on switches (plan section 3 step 6: market-rate, affordable, community facility; section 6: qualifying affordable or senior housing, community facility, ground-floor commercial).

assumptions.description: Explicit assumptions of this option (plan section 9 'Explicit assumptions'); shown on the report's assumptions page.

existing_building_plan.description: Keep or remove the existing building (plan section 3 step 4). When kept, the floor-area allowance subtracts the existing ZONING floor area (site fact existing_zoning_floor_area), never recorded building area. The section 5b keep / partial-rebuild / full-rebuild comparison is always computed side by side in results.

goal.description: The stated goal of 'Best combination': by default most residential floor area, or another goal the architect picks such as most total floor area (plan section 5). 'other' requires the goal in words.

text.description: The goal in words; required for 'other', null otherwise.

floor_to_floor_heights.description: Floor-to-floor heights: editable, with stated defaults (plan section 5 'Floor stack', section 3 step 6).

per_floor_overrides.description: Architect-entered heights for specific floors (1 = ground floor).

height_setting.description: One floor-to-floor height with its basis. A default is always stated in words so it is shown as a default, never silently applied.

statement.description: Plain-English statement, e.g. 'Default ground-floor height 12 ft (editable)'.

revision.description: Study revision (task M1-11; the report is bound to a revision, section 9 'Option B · revision 7 · date'). Revision 1 has no parent; every later revision names its parent revision number.

origin.description: How the study started. 'copied_from_export' = 'Start a new study from this': inputs are copied, facts re-fetched and results recalculated; nothing imported becomes a current fact or result (plan section 9 'Historical exports'; export_record.schema.json restore_policy).
